storage: volume JSONL <archive>/github_activity/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl (append-only; one growing file, not one-per-poll — record volume is tiny, <=15/week)
license: GitHub API Terms: CONDITIONAL — aggregated, non-personal counts (merged-PR totals, commit totals, bot-filtered unique-actor sample) are an accepted keyless use; no per-user profiling beyond the public commit author field already used to exclude bot accounts.

field_map.ticker: public-company ticker mapped to this org (hand-verified watchlist, see githubOrgActivity.ts header)
field_map.weekStart: Monday UTC of the archived week (YYYY-MM-DD)
field_map.weekEnd: Sunday UTC of the archived week, inclusive
field_map.mergedPRs: merged PR count for the org that week, GitHub-App bot authors (dependabot/renovate/github-actions) excluded via the API's own author:app/<slug> qualifier; null if the query failed
field_map.commits: total commit count for the org that week across all branches indexed by GitHub's search API — NOT bot-filtered (see HONEST GAPS below); null if the query failed
field_map.uniqueActorsSample: unique non-bot committer identities within the first 100 returned commit items only — a SAMPLE, not a full-org unique count
field_map.actorSampleCapped: true when the week's true commit count exceeds the 100-item sample window, meaning uniqueActorsSample undercounts
field_map.rt: as-seen date (UTC day the archiver ran)

confidence_model: GATE 1 (DATA) ONLY. No signal validated yet (gate 2, deliberately not attempted this session). SOBER PRIOR stated before building: public GitHub activity is a strategic, biased slice — real signal only for names that genuinely develop in public; noise for the rest of the watchlist. The split itself, once gate 2 runs, is the finding.
cadence: 24h check; the underlying metric is weekly-granularity and each org/week is fetched at most once (isArchived skip) — the 24h cadence exists for retry robustness across frequent redeploys, not to refetch a completed week
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
